sitting_steps: One apply owner for this sitting (parent recovery → interrupt the model subagent first)
Confirm the world is open (MCP up) — ghost may look sparse/empty around the cell
Reset the 3×3 ghost baseline: `AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff python3 scripts/model_bakeoff.py baseline {id}` (undoes prior feature builds, lidar_ghost apply --force, reconcile)
Claim site lock; build with that tool/model only
Read packs/{pack}/BRIEF.md + packs/{pack}/FAIRNESS.md (and repair_brief if kind=repair)
Build from evidence table — not a previous Minecraft build
Log footprint pad: pad_cells / osm_cells (square only to kill 1-block stairs, not a fixed +2 halo)
Apply, then capture fixed cameras: `AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff python3 scripts/model_bakeoff.py capture {id}`; release lock
Interview + score; then usage paste (need-you if counts unknown)
sitting_steps_hybrid: One apply owner for this sitting: the builder ({model}); parent recovery must interrupt the builder subagent first
Confirm the world is open (MCP up) — ghost may look sparse/empty around the cell
Reset the 3×3 ghost baseline: `AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff python3 scripts/model_bakeoff.py baseline {id}` (undoes prior feature builds, lidar_ghost apply --force, reconcile)
Designer ({designer}) only: read packs/{pack}/BRIEF.md + packs/{pack}/FAIRNESS.md; write the evidence table + build spec/script (do not apply)
Record the hand-off path: `open`/`score --handoff <path>` (spec or script the builder will run)
Builder ({model}) only: claim site lock; apply from the hand-off artefact — do not redesign massing
Log footprint pad: pad_cells / osm_cells (square only to kill 1-block stairs, not a fixed +2 halo)
Builder applies, then capture fixed cameras: `AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff python3 scripts/model_bakeoff.py capture {id}`; release lock
Interview + score; then usage from transcript (auto-splits designer vs builder) + plan % (need-you if counts unknown)
